timing: Before any of the three arm render results is available to the parent
qualification: Every required endpoint, owner and contact must be simultaneously observable; partial and unobservable do not pass. No anatomy, intent, function, age or identity inference from appearance. Visual-reference resemblance is a separate appearance observation, never person identification.

A: Wearable frame remains outside the human limb; cuffs, links and human limb remain distinguishable.
Human hand grip and the load/support target are attributable to distinct physical owners.
Every elected candidate-specific source contract is reviewed whole, without counting a local metallic connector as the whole path.
B: Piloted machine and portrait-guided human remain distinguishable in scale and ownership.
Selected cockpit access, seat, control, boot, harness or platform relations must be judged individually from actual elected source contracts.
Landscape and machine-scale impression cannot substitute for hidden cockpit endpoints.
C: Human mechanic and separate service robot remain distinct physical owners.
Robot forearm opening, mechanical interior, tool shaft/tip and actual serviced target must be visible if required by elected source.
Warm/cool atmosphere cannot substitute for missing mechanical tool contact.

comparison_policy: Use frozen baseline, authored pre-retrieval testcase, selected optional candidate decision and exact final prompt to delimit individual obligations. Parent does not revise gates after seeing results.
broad_coverage_limit: Three single-scene initial renders cannot prove all 106 positive candidates or 323 original term routes.
